$comment: Every supported target, keyed by device, region and kernel release. The
files for an entry live at
derived, never written here, so the two cannot drift apart.
This is the hand-authored half of the support feed. Artifact URLs and
sizes are not here: they are only knowable after CI builds them, and
tools/generate_feed.py joins the two into the targets-v2.json the app
kernelVersion is the complete /proc/version line and kernelBuildVersion is
the '#<n> SMP ...' part of it. Both must be captured from a running device
(`adb shell cat /proc/version`) -- they cannot be derived from a firmware
image. A target whose kernelVersion is null is carried here but left out
of the feed, because the app matches on those exact strings.

targets.status: the LD_PRELOAD build roots this device; the app payload the feed serves still cross-checks the slide against slide_p0_offset, which is two numbers here and one on Samsung
